title: glechoma racemosa
intro: Glechoma racemosa, commonly known as Creeping Jenny or Ground Ivy, is a perennial flowering plant native to Europe, Western Asia, and North Africa. It has been used in traditional medicine for centuries, offering various health benefits such as reducing inflammation, improving digestion, and relieving respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Glechoma racemosa include its antimicrobial, antispasmodic, and expectorant properties, which help to soothe and protect the body. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, terpenoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
